edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Edit the provided Intelligence Help guide concept. Preserve the entire existing layout, typography, palette, icons, sidebar, cards and all other copy exactly. Change ONLY the explanatory sentence below 'Always allow for this agent'. Replace 'Let this agent make similar requests without asking again.' with the exact text 'Keep this exact access enabled for this agent until you revoke it.' This is crucial: permanent permission is the approved exact scope, not an open-ended class of similar requests. It may wrap onto two lines within the current card; keep the card and page readable and no clipped text. No new elements or branding.
